description: This file defines the IUSBDevice interface for managing USB devices, including device information structures, notification mechanisms, and methods for device enumeration, info retrieval, and driver binding/unbinding within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IUSBDevice
classes.description: Interface for USB device management, including device info, notifications, and driver control.

classes.name: IUSBDevice::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for USB device plug-in and plug-out events.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Structure representing basic USB device information.

classes.name: USBProductInfo
classes.description: Structure representing USB product details such as language ID, serial number, manufacturer, and product name.

classes.name: USBDeviceInfo
classes.description: Detailed information about a USB device, including IDs, status, speed, and associated product info.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific USB device by name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds the driver to a specified USB device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds the driver from a specified USB device.
